maya (PM): quick sync 0min: define a compact req/resp schema for launch. Goals: tiny payloads, explicit token accounting, deterministic trace ids.

sam (API): flat keys only. mobile customers care about bytes.

linda (Eng): propose tele_ prefix: tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_cost_micros. server may fill tele_total_tokens if not present.

rahul (ML): align naming with model teams: prompt/completion. embeddings -> emb + emb_dim. rerank -> rank_score + rank_pos.

noah (DevEx): trace_id: require 16-hex (8 bytes) at top-level; optional parent_id and client_request_id. docs warn against PII in ids.

sam (API): tool calls: flat suffix keys tele_tool_0_name/status/out_bytes, cap N=5 to bound payload. tele_route optional.

linda (Eng): gateway will enrich token splits and cost so clients can stay minimal; server values supersede client-sent metrics.

maya (PM): launch gates: spec doc + examples, SDK mappings (py/ts/go), gateway canary (48h no regressions), telemetry pipeline acceptance.

ops-bot: deploy-gateway v1.12 canary 2026-04-02T02:00Z.

maya (PM): action items: sam -> draft spec today; noah -> SDK checklist; linda -> schedule canary infra; rahul -> add token-accounting CI. Reconvene Thu. :rocket:
